title: Find Triangular Sum of an Array
goal: Reduce adjacent digit sums modulo ten until one value remains.
strategy: Every new row is computed from neighboring pairs of the previous row. Build a fresh row before replacing the old one so earlier updates cannot contaminate later sums.
